author: Bobby Grayson
description: New file Leanactors/Examples/LockLive.lean (imports Leanactors.Fair, Leanactors.Examples.LockFcfs); wired into Leanactors.lean after LockFcfs. Main theorem: eventually_holds (n) (ρ : CRun beh EnvStep) (h0 : ρ.st 0 = initCfg n) (hfair : ∀ p, ρ.WeakFair (.run p)) (henv : ∀ h, ρ.EnvFair (Holds h) (fun a b => b = a.deliver h .tick)) : ∀ t x, (ρ.st t).stateOf x = some .client_await0 → ∃ t' ≥ t, (ρ.st t').stateOf x = some (.client .holding). Proved in full, no weakening. Structure: waits_leadsTo_holds = token case split (Waits.token) over requested_leadsTo (rank_leads_to_run server, measure idxOf c server (acquire x)), queued_leadsTo_granted (LeadsTo.rank_induction on rank (queueOf c) x; per rank R_leadsTo_G chains holder_granted_leadsTo / holder_holds_leadsTo (stable_until_env) / holder_ticked_leadsTo / holder_released_leadsTo), granted_leadsTo_holds (rank_leads_to_run x, measure idxOf c x (reply ok)). Only one measure family: idxOf c q m = index of first m in q's mailbox; Has.append / Has.pop are the two mailbox lemmas. Invariant facts added: Inv.a_le_one, Inv.g_le_one, HolderIs.srv/ne_of_mem/g_queued/token/of_granted/of_holds, Waits.token, holder_of_queued. Step lemmas: CStepL.run_facts (Step.chars minus counts), EnvStep.facts, Waits.step, Holds.step, HolderIs.step, queued_step. README line for the table: Lock | ... liveness: a blocked client eventually holds under weak fairness + holder-tick env fairness (LockLive.lean). Suggested README layout row: Leanactors/Examples/LockLive.lean | Liveness: eventually_holds along a fair CRun, three phases (request in server mailbox, queued with rank induction over handovers, grant in own mailbox), each a LeadsTo from Fair.lean workhorses. Deferral of messages ahead of the reply handled directly by the idx measure (re-enqueue appends at tail so the index drops).
title: LockLive integration notes
